# Luca Nerlich - Tech Documentation

> > Technical documentation hub covering Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, with beginner guides and production patterns.

Luca Nerlich's documentation site provides comprehensive guides for AEM development (HTL, Sling Models, Touch UI, Content Fragments), modern Java features (streams, concurrency, functional programming), and JavaScript/TypeScript best practices. Content ranges from beginner tutorials to advanced reference material.

## Key Topics

- Adobe Experience Manager (AEM)
- Sling Models & JCR
- HTL (HTML Template Language)
- Touch UI & Granite UI
- Editable Templates & Policies
- Core Components
- Java Streams & Concurrency
- TypeScript
- OSGi
- Content Fragments
- Coral UI
- Maven
- CompletableFuture
- Dialog Development
- Intl API

## AEM Beginner Guides

- [The JCR & Sling](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/beginners-guide/jcr-and-sling): JCR content repository & Sling URL resolution fundamentals for AEM
- [Your First Component](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/beginners-guide/your-first-component): Build your first AEM component: HTL template, Sling Model, dialog XML explained
- [Templates & Policies](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/beginners-guide/templates-and-policies): AEM editable templates, policies, structure vs initial content, allowed components

## AEM Components & Development

- [Components Overview](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/components): AEM component guides: overview, Core Components, dialog validation, templates
- [Touch UI Component Dialogs](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/component-dialogs): Coral XML dialog reference for AEM Touch UI component configuration
- [Templates and Policies](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/components/templates-policies): Editable Templates & Policies: structure, configuration, allowed components
- [Sling Model Annotations Reference](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/components/annotations/sling-model-annotations): Comprehensive Sling Model annotations reference: @Model, @ValueMapValue, etc.
- [Content Fragments](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/content/content-fragments): AEM Content Fragments: models, structured content, GraphQL, headless CMS

## AEM Touch UI & Customization

- [Coral UI](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/ui/coral-ui): Adobe's Coral UI web component library for AEM Touch UI development
- [Overlays](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/ui/overlays): Sling Resource Merger overlays for customizing AEM Touch UI without /libs edits
- [Render Conditions](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/ui/render-conditions): Granite UI render conditions: show/hide dialog fields by user group or context
- [Multi-Tenancy UI Frontend Themes](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/ui/multi-tenancy-support-ui-frontend): Configure webpack & ui.frontend for multi-tenant AEM clientlibs per brand
- [Groovy Console](https://lucanerlich.com/aem/groovy-console): AEM Groovy Console guide: installation, scripting, bulk content operations

## Java Development

- [Java Overview](https://lucanerlich.com/java): Java guides: streams, concurrency, generics, testing, Maven, modern features
- [Introduction & Environment Setup](https://lucanerlich.com/java/beginners-guide/introduction): Java intro: JDK/JRE/JVM explained, installation, first program, IDE setup
- [Functional Interfaces and Lambdas](https://lucanerlich.com/java/functional-interfaces): Java functional interfaces: Function, Predicate, Consumer, lambdas, composition

## JavaScript & TypeScript

- [JavaScript Overview](https://lucanerlich.com/javascript): JavaScript & TypeScript guides: Intl API, error handling, performance tips
- [TypeScript Guide](https://lucanerlich.com/javascript/beginners-guide/typescript): TypeScript guide: type annotations, interfaces, generics, project setup

## Additional Resources

- [Home](https://lucanerlich.com): Tech documentation hub for AEM, Java, JavaScript, Strapi with code examples
- [Mermaid Diagrams Guide](https://lucanerlich.com/other/mermaid-diagrams): Mermaid diagram guide: flowcharts, sequence diagrams, class diagrams in Markdown
